One of the best Italian places I’ve eaten at.
Aug 2026 • Family
I’ve heard a lot about Pizza 4P’s prior to travelling to Vietnam, so it was a must for me to see what the hype was all about. 

Food: the food lived up to its hype. we had the crabmeat spaghetti (to share) as well as other sharing plates but it was so good, we had to order another. The salad had delicious dressing and I wouldn’t mind eating that on its own too. 

Atmosphere: it was dark & moody, would be great for date nights or catch ups with your friends. Yet, not too snobbish where you have to dress a certain way. No dress code, comfortable setting. Good for casual dinners and date nights. 

Service: As the restaurant is very busy, we could only eat at odd times (9pm). So be prepared to wait or try and make a booking weeks in advance - we tried 2 weeks ahead and still couldn’t get a reservation. Luckily, the staff were very nice to put us on the waitlist and will text us when our turn was near. 

Value: so reasonable! normally where I’m from, crabmeat would be 300,000 - 400,000 VND but it was 258,000 VND per serving. 

We loved Pizza 4P’s so much, we went there twice during our 4 day trip 🌟🌟🌟

Pizza 4P's, Da Nang, Vietnam
Aug 2026 • Family
On a scale of 1 to 5, I rate restaurants from a personal perspective.

【Location】3
I walked because it was close to the hotel. There were other shops, so I don't think it's bad. It was not that noisy.

【Atmosphere】4
It was a lovely space inside, not so different from being in Japan.

【Cooking】3
I think the pizzas were all good.

【Customer service】3
There's nothing wrong with great customer service.

【Price Performance】2
It's a pretty high setting for Da Nang. I felt it was a bit cheaper than in Japan.

【General】3
It's a bit of a rickety pizza restaurant with Japanese spacing. It tasted good, but I thought I could eat it in Japan. I guess I wanted something different. But if you live in the local area and want to eat in style once in a while, you may want to get inspired.

The food is pretty good, but I think it's expensive.

Great
Apr 2026 • Solo
There are some places when you're traveling that you look for and look for and look for and can't find. And then you suddenly discover them by accident. This restaurant has given me the best experience in Vietnam so far. I've been traveling around the country for a month now. And I'm really getting a little tired of the classic local food. If you're looking for it - you won't find it here. But you will find delicious pizzas from a wood-fired oven. Hardworking young guys make them literally in front of you. There are a lot of staff throughout the restaurant and they are very well organized. I hope the boss really appreciates their effort and that they are adequately paid for their work. In addition to the pizza, I was also delighted by the platter with various rich cheeses and salamis. I come from the Balkans (Croatia) and this platter reminded me of the region where I come from. I missed it a lot, this is the first time since mid-January, when I left for Asia, that I've eaten something like this. Their desserts and drinks are also excellent. The sangria is delicious, like in Spain. The prices are a little higher, but well deserved. This place is a real little culinary paradise. From what I've seen, both tourists and locals come in. It's located on the other side of the river, once you pass Dragon Bridge, very close to the bridge.

A Pizza Experience I Didn’t Expect in Da Nang
Sep 2025 • Solo
When you think of Vietnam, pizza is probably not the first thing that comes to mind. But Pizza 4Ps in Da Nang will totally change that. I got their half-and-half pizza with 4 Cheese and Burrata Ham Margherita, and it was incredible.

The 4 Cheese pizza has a perfect balance of sweet and salty. You absolutely have to try it with honey for the full experience. The crust is my favorite part: crispy on the outside, chewy in the middle, and never soggy. They also have house-made chili oil that is just spicy enough to hit the back of your throat without overwhelming the flavors.

The Burrata Ham Margherita is creamy and dreamy. The ham is thinly sliced, smoky, and not too salty. I like adding just honey to this one, skipping the chili oil so the flavors really shine.

I sat at the bar counter facing the open kitchen and loved watching how they make each pizza fresh from scratch. If you are a pizza lover or just want something different while in Da Nang, 4Ps Pizza is an absolute must-visit.

It was the perfect choice for dinner on the first day of Vietnam, as it was run by a Japanese owner.
The restaurant was stylish and clean, and the staff were very responsive, so I enjoyed it slowly.

Pizza with homemade burrata cheese and salad with organic vegetables were all delicious.
There's a lot of pizza to choose from, and I'm glad I never got tired of being able to order half and half.

The two large pizza ovens in the shop were very impressive.
